question: Who among the following was the first chairperson of National Commission for Women and a senior congress leader who passed away in 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jayanti Patnaik**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jayanti Patnaik** was a senior Congress leader who served as the **first chairperson of the National Commission for Women (NCW)** in India.
 
• She held this position from its inception in **1992** until **1998**.
 
• She passed away in **2022**, and her contributions to women's rights and social issues in India were widely recognized.
 
• She joined the **Indian National Congress** and became an influential figure in the party, serving in various roles, including that of a member of the **Rajya Sabha** (the upper house of India's Parliament).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ambika Son**i

 
 
• **Ambika Soni is a prominent Indian politician and a senior member of the Indian National Congress party.**
 
• She **has held various ministerial positions, including the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting.**

 She is known for her work in promoting media and culture,
 
• She has played a significant role in Indian politics, particularly in the realms of education and women's empowerment
 
 
 
• **Sushmita Dev**
 
 
• **Sushmita Dev is a Congress politician and former president of the Mahila Congress.**
 
• She has served as a Member of Parliament and has been vocal about women's rights and empowerment.
 
 
 
• **Sheila Dikshi**t
 
 
• **Sheila Dikshit was a prominent Indian politician who served as the Chief Minister of Delhi for three consecutive terms from 1998 to 2013.**
 
• She was a senior Congress leader with significant influence in Delhi politics.
 
• She focused on urban development, women's empowerment, and improving infrastructure in Delhi.
